correctness.rationale: The published correction determinant and the published all-collinear vanishing-ideal theorem supply the input. Restriction to the baseline component makes all 3x3 minors vanish identically. Exact algebra rewrites the correction as the fixed-cross-ratio numerator. Its affine Hessian has kernel exactly the common-shift direction because every principal 3x3 minor is \(2\prod_{i<j}(v_j-v_i)\neq0\). Therefore the singular locus is exactly the small diagonal; the rank-three transverse quadratic form gives \(A_1\), and irreducible hypersurface plus codimension-two singular locus gives normality by Serre's criterion. The bundled exact-symbolic replay checks all determinant and Hessian identities.
